newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis, Palestinians clash in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israelis, Palestinians clash in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli troops wounded at least one Palestinian in the third straight day of clashes with stone-throwing Arabs in the divided West Bank town of Hebron on Monday, witnesses said.
They said about 100 youths hurled stones at Israeli soldiers dressed in riot gear along the line that divides Hebron into Israeli and Palestinian-controlled areas.
Soldiers responded with rubber bullets. Witnesses said at least one person was hit and lightly wounded.
Palestinians said troops had not been using tear gas to quell demonstrations on request from the city's 400 Jewish settlers who had complained the fumes were bothering them.
An Israeli army spokeswoman said she was checking the report.

Israeli soldiers shot and wounded dozens of Palestinians on Saturday and Sunday during clashes that erupted over a recent U.S. House of Representatives vote calling on President Bill Clinton to recognise Arab East Jerusalem as part of Israel's undivided capital.
The unrest underscored the fragility of Israel-PLO peace
